column2: Okay, so this is Paper Coach Studio! It's the private web app where Zak and Claude make, ship, and run a whole drawing app.
Paper Coach teaches you to draw on real paper, one line at a time. Let me show you around.
First up, Paths. This is the whole curriculum: twelve paths, a hundred and twenty lessons.
Open one up, and check this out. Every single stroke is timed, and coloured by step, in the order a real person would draw it.
And here's the cool part: Claude plans all of that from a drawing. What goes first, what Lina says at each step, all of it.
Zak tweaks whatever he wants, previews it just like the app plays it, and publishes it for the next release.
Speaking of Lina, she's the teacher's voice in the app. And she was cast right here, in Voice.
You describe a person in a sentence, and the voice server invents her. Every voice reads the same lines, so you can hear them side by side.
Pick one, freeze it, and every step of every lesson gets narrated in that exact voice. And all of it runs on Zak's own Mac. No cloud, no bill per word.
Okay. Now this is the one that gets me. Learners!
